blurb: Guests join fishing charters from Scituate, MA, fishing around Boston Harbor, Stellwagen Bank, Mass Bay, Cape Cod Bay, and Plymouth. They target species including sharks, tuna, cod, haddock, striped bass, and bluefish. Trips cater to anglers of all skill levels and include family-friendly options like kids fishing charters and lobster trap pulling.
